_about: Every input of scripts/build_state_map.ts. The build checks each committed file against its sha256 and stops on a mismatch. To refresh: download the zip from its URL, check it, unzip the workbook here, then update the sha256 values and the retrieved date.

files.title: OEWS May 2025 state estimates, all occupations, all 54 state-level areas (50 states, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico, Virgin Islands), the workbook from the zip, bytes unchanged
files.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS)

files.title: Display coordinates for the 54 areas (US Census Bureau centroids, not BLS data), copied from src/data/geo_real.json at c7a7e55
files.publisher: US Census Bureau (via the app's earlier src/data/geo_real.json)

files.title: The earlier Kelley state data (src/data/geo_real.json at c7a7e55, built 2026-08-29 from the BLS public API by scripts/refresh_oes_data.mjs), bytes unchanged. Kept only so docs/state-map.md can list exactly what changed when the map moved to the state file
files.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, public data API (OEWS series)
